intro: The coast has become a battlefield, and every harbor, convoy, and battery now matters. The Black Sea war ties the front to ports, convoys, and coastal strongholds. The wider stakes are clear: You have shown that it is a mistake to think the Red Army is an easy prey! Coordinate ships, aircraft, coastal guns, and landing forces carefully; one exposed transport can undo the entire plan.
